user_goal: Make FRIDAY the independent human control surface for the existing machine so ChatGPT is not the only door.

adaptive_pass_rule.stop_reason: Internal estate recovery, external mechanism search, and a hostile counter-search converged. Another research pass was lower value than a bounded implementation test.
directions: PersonalJarvis capability routing, isolated worker/critic, action gateway, private evidence learning, and headless control surfaces
MCP vendor-neutral tools/resources transport and scoped gateway security
local voice and browser clients including OpenVoiceOS, Home Assistant Assist/Wyoming, and Open WebUI
counter-search for upstream CI/release instability and privileged UI security failures

architecture.name: FRIDAY Foundry Gateway V0
architecture.rule: FRIDAY may recover, route, queue, learn from evidence, propose drafts, and request approval. It may not grant itself authority, execute live actions, approve, merge, deploy, publish, spend, delete, or activate.

salvage.rights: Apache-2.0; upstream NOTICE preserved in warehouse; no upstream source, branding, models, voice assets, or UI copied into FRIDAY candidate
rejected_or_deferred: wholesale PersonalJarvis fork: too large and current upstream CI/release evidence is not clean enough
Open WebUI as privileged control plane: rejected due recent tool/MCP access-control advisories
Letta self-editing memory: deferred because evidence-backed learning plus verified capsules already cover the need with a safer authority boundary
always-on local voice: deferred until the text/MCP owner-device field path is proven

next_bounded_action.action: Connect PersonalJarvis to friday-foundry over pinned stdio MCP on Randy's device, then perform one verified recover -> bounded work order -> receipt loop.
next_bounded_action.acceptance: The client launches the gateway, rejects tampered truth, recovers the pinned capsule, queues exactly one non-live work order, and shows its persisted receipt without ChatGPT acting as clipboard.
next_bounded_action.stop_condition: Stop for Randy review before merge, deployment, activation, authority broadening, or live external action.
next_bounded_action.blocker: BLOCKED_OWNER_DEVICE: this session has GitHub and CI access but not Randy's Windows/phone execution environment.
